frontend_requirements: Dynamic website built with a framework like React, Vue.js, or Angular for the booking module.
backend_requirements: Server using Node.js, Django, or Ruby on Rails to handle booking requests and interact with the database.
a2a_ocl_constraints: context Booking inv: self.date != "unavailable" and self.time != "unavailable"
context API inv: self.requests->forAll(r | r.status = "success" implies r.response_time <= 200)
mermaid_syntax: graph TD; A[Frontend]-->B[Booking Module]; B-->C[API]; C-->D[Database]; C-->E[Error Handling]; D-->F[Admin Interface];
